transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got an urgent bracket order that needs to get moving, and I understand the refurbished stamping die D-18 is available with Press 2 currently listed as the planned machine. Before I make the production authorization, I need to run through our standard pre-run gate. I'd like maintenance and quality engineering to state any unresolved technical or release conditions so I can make a proper go/no-go call. Also, I'm aware Press 5 is idle through the end of the week if we need an alternative assignment — provided the tooling and release requirements are satisfied. Let's hear where things stand.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical issue. The refurbishment shop's fit report, which I received by email yesterday but haven't yet entered in the maintenance work order, shows that D-18's lower shoe is incompatible with Press 2 due to a 0.25 mm bolster mismatch. The die is only compatible with Press 5. Additionally, installing the replacement guide-post set on Press 5 requires exactly 6 hours.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a quality release condition to flag. During my review of the current customer drawing in the quality portal this morning — which I haven't yet attached to the job traveler — I found that the revised bracket specification requires 50 consecutive dimensional-validation pieces and a process capability result of at least Cpk 1.33 before any production pieces can be released. This is a mandatory release condition that needs to be satisfied regardless of which press we assign.
